title: A Bridge for the Ledger
author: Casper Delacroix
blurb: Silas Blackwood, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
